[doc][core] Fix mechanical errors flagged by the Ray Core style pass (#66790)

## Why are these changes needed?

The Ray Core style-pass stack, #66642 through #66677, flagged
pre-existing problems in the pages it edited and left them as written,
because a style pass shouldn't change claims. This PR fixes the ones
that don't change a technical claim. It's stacked on #66677, the top of
that stack, because it edits lines on pages across every layer.

Each fix is settled by the page itself, its own code sample, or a
renamed symbol:

- `configure.md`: the default worker port range 10002 to 19999 holds
9,998 ports, so the per-node worker maximum is 9,998, not 10,000.
- `user-spawn-processes.md`: the deprecation note told readers to enable
`process_group_cleanup_enabled`, which L19 of the same page says is on
by default.
- `type-hint.md`: the Pattern 2 sample uses `ray` and `ObjectRef`
without importing them.
- `actors/terminating-actors.md`: the front-matter description said
cleanup runs when `ray.shutdown` is called, which the page never says.
It now names the `__ray_shutdown__` method the page covers. The
`sys.exit` sentence sits below the Python, Java, and C++ tabs, so it now
scopes `sys.exit` to Python.
- `objects/object-spilling.md`: the CLI tab wrapped a `ray start` shell
command in a `{doctest}` fence. It's now `bash`.
- `patterns/nested-ray-get.md` and
`patterns/out-of-band-object-ref-serialization.md`: the front-matter
descriptions contradicted their page bodies ("serializes execution",
"can let its value be reclaimed early"). They now summarize what the
bodies say.
- `scheduling/memory-management.md`: the prose named a "Reference
Creation Site" column, but every `ray memory` sample on the page labels
it "Call Site". "In Ray 1.3 and later" is gone, since every supported
release is 2.x.
- `scheduling/ray-oom-prevention.md`: "how to address memory issues"
linked to a label left on the "Questions or issues?" section after
#63652 deleted the section it named. It now links to the out-of-memory
troubleshooting guide that #63652 expanded, and the orphaned label is
gone. Nothing else in `doc/source` targets it.
- `scheduling/resources.md`: the lead-in said the rules configure
"logical resources", but one rule in the list says object store memory
isn't a logical resource.
- `compiled-graph/overlap.md`: overlap "reduces" latency by about 14%,
rather than "improves" it. The page's output shows 1.0670 s to 0.9211 s.
- `compiled-graph/profiling.md`: NVIDIA's product is Nsight Systems. A
`(nsight-system-profiler)=` label keeps the old heading fragment
working.
- `internals/token-authentication.md`: two notes said that new HTTP
services must add the middleware and header injection themselves. The
first one goes, and the one in the "Adding token authentication to new
services" section stays.
- `examples/monte-carlo-pi.md`: the task takes exactly `num_samples`
samples, not "up to".
- `examples/index.md`: five link texts didn't match the titles of the
notebooks they link to. They now render the live titles.
- `internals/object-spilling.md`: "GCS" in the cloud storage passages
meant Google Cloud Storage, which reads as Ray's GCS on a Ray Core page.
`ReleaseFreedObject` is now `ReleaseFreedLocalObject`, renamed in
#63218. The two `PopDeleteWorker` links pointed at different lines of
`worker_pool.cc`, and the `blob/master` anchors had drifted. Those three
links are now pinned to a commit. The page's other `blob/master` links
have drifted too and need symbol-by-symbol remapping, which is left for
a follow-up.
- `internals/ray-event-exporter.md`: the Step 5 link text named
`AddEvent()`, but the function at the pinned commit and on master is
`AddEvents()`. The Step 6 `AggregatorAgent` link pointed at the default
event list, at the same anchor as Step 4, rather than the class.
- `internals/metric-exporter.md`: the `SetMetricValue()` link pointed at
a call site in `metric.cc`. It now points at the definition, which other
links on the page already use.

Not included: two typos in the `scheduling/labels.md` operator table,
curly quotes in code spans and "anything by one value", which sit on
lines that #66550 edits.

## Related issue number

None. Not a duplicate: I searched open PRs touching `doc/source/core/`
and `doc/source/ray-core/`. Open PRs editing these pages are this stack,
#66464 (Compiled Graph deprecation banners, on lines this PR doesn't
touch), and #66550 (left alone as described above).

## Checks

- Docs-only: every change is in a `.md` file under `doc/source/core/`,
so no library tests run.
- `vale` on the 18 changed files from the repo root: the same alerts as
the base branch, with none added.
- `codespell` on the changed files: clean.
- `doc/.claude/skills/ray-soft-wrap/scripts/softwrap.py --check` on the
changed files: clean.
- Every link changed here was checked against the file at its pinned
commit, at the line it names.
- `pre-commit`: passed.
- Full `-W` doc build: relying on the Read the Docs preview.

AI assistance (Claude Code) was used to draft these edits. Draft until
the submitter has reviewed every changed line.
